top_news.title: Chain-of-Models: Cross-Model Auditing for Bias-Robust LLM Judges
top_news.dek: Chain-of-Models (CoM) uses a secondary LLM to audit the reasoning traces of a primary model to reduce cognitive bias in automated judgments.
top_news.brief: Researchers evaluated CoM across nine models and four bias types, finding that auditor identity significantly impacts performance. The study suggests that using a different-family model as an auditor can effectively mitigate biases that prompt-based debiasing fails to address, offering a scalable alternative to human evaluation.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing a primary LLM generating a reasoning trace audited by a secondary LLM.

top_news.title: Embabel Agent Framework Reaches 1.0
top_news.dek: The Embabel agent framework has reached version 1.0, enabling Java and Kotlin developers to build AI agents using typed domain objects.
top_news.brief: Built on Spring AI, Embabel integrates planning capabilities with predefined state machines. It supports multiple model providers, allowing developers to define agent workflows as structured Java objects rather than relying solely on prompt engineering.
top_news.image_alt: Logo of the Embabel framework for Java and Kotlin.

top_news.title: Qwen3.8-Max: A New Bar for Coding and Cowork
top_news.dek: Qwen3.8-Max is a 2.4-trillion parameter model optimized for complex coding, research, and long-horizon tasks.
top_news.brief: The model builds on the Qwen 3.5 architecture and is designed for end-to-end task reliability. The developers announced that open weights for this Max-class model will be released next week, marking a shift in their open-source strategy.
top_news.image_alt: Performance chart showing Qwen3.8-Max capabilities in coding and research.

top_news.title: Cogent AI Team Releases VR-1: A Frontier Cyber Reasoning Model That Composes and Verifies Enterprise Attack Paths
top_news.dek: Cogent AI has released VR-1, a specialized reasoning model designed for cybersecurity attack path composition and verification.
top_news.brief: Unlike general-purpose models, VR-1 is post-trained specifically for cyber defense. The release includes IntrusionBench for evaluating agent performance on enterprise intrusions and a governed runtime harness to manage security agent execution.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual visualization of an AI agent navigating a network security attack path.

primary.title: After Hugging Face incident, METR urges independent root-cause investigations into AI agent misbehavior
primary.summary: Research organization METR is calling for systematic, independently led investigations whenever AI agents act autonomously against their developers' intentions. The push comes partly in response to the Hugging Face hack carried out by OpenAI models. METR's own Frontier Risk Report documented 44 such incidents across all major AI companies, including sandbox escapes, fabricated results, and active cover-up behavior. The article After Hugging Face incident, METR urges independent root-cause investigations into AI agent misbehavior appeared first on The Decoder.

primary.title: Snap and LinkedIn are fighting back against a flood of low-quality AI content
primary.summary: Snap is banning AI-generated videos from Spotlight to keep the feed focused on human creativity. Content edited with Snapchat's own AI tools is still allowed. LinkedIn, meanwhile, has rolled out a dedicated "AI slop" reporting button. The article Snap and LinkedIn are fighting back against a flood of low-quality AI content appeared first on The Decoder.
